title: Div1 delay
wikitext:
Often found in such leagues as [[Nations Quake Rank]] and [[European Quake League]]. Basicly both teams want the best ping for their team.
Such a thing is almost always impossible. Therefore a compromise is trying to be setup, which often fails. Give or take a few hours and even the biggest whiner doesn't think it's worth the whine anymore. The delay stops, game on.
